/\ eval[d].in = pending /\ eval[d].rev = rev
  /\ ~Faults(eval[d].in)
  /\ consumed' = Append(consumed, eval[d].in)
  /\ pending' = pending \ eval[d].in

/\ eval[d].rev = rev
  /\ ~Faults(eval[d].in)
  /\ consumed' = Append(consumed, eval[d].in)
  /\ pending' = {}
